name: The course as the team taped it, 2026-11-08 (Michael Bar On's course map)
notes: The team (@jsun4231, 2026-11-08) takes this map as the real arena wherever it differs from the STEP export. Every number below is from the source map or its README; anything it marks assumed or estimated stays so here.

Edits apply in order: remove, move, replace, add. Positions are course frame (x east, y north, metres, origin at the floor centre). A move gives the feature's centre in the STEP (from) and in the taped map (to); applying it translates the named features by to - from, after checking each named feature's centre is within 0.01 m of from.

Unchanged from the STEP: the barriers, A1, C1, C2a's position and width, C2b, the tube and its cradles, the launch mark and the nets. The source map's tube (open 0.03-1.85 m) and walls (1.73 m) agree with the STEP to 2 cm.
The flight height the source map flies is the window's middle, 1.23 m above the floor: a planning choice, passed to the converter as --slice-height.

remove.name: Part67 / Boss-Extrude1[2]
remove.why: The CAD export's diagonal wall, longer than the taped one: it would leave under 0.6 m to the north wall, which the taped gap (about 3 ft) rules out (source README).

remove.name: Part67 / Boss-Extrude1[1]
remove.why: The CAD's north-west block lies north of the taped north wall, outside the arena. It is not in the source map.

remove.name: Boulder 2
remove.why: The course has no rock south of the tunnel's south mouth (source commit 6d8e140).

move.why: Against the east net, level with the turn south of the tunnel. Estimated from the team's photos, not taped (source commit e39f109).
Against the south net, east of the window. Estimated, not taped (source commit e39f109).
The rock west of the window, about a foot from the south net. Taped roughly (source commit b5d640e).

The pad's centre is 36 in from the west net and 48 in from the south net, about a metre south of the published pad. Taped roughly (source commit b5d640e). The approach ring is concentric with the pad and moves with it (assumed).

replace.name: C2a chicane wall (window)
replace.why: The window opening was taped at 36-61 in above the floor (0.914-1.549 m), not the published 12-48 in (source commit 22c65e1). Its width and place along the wall are unchanged; the wall itself is the STEP's.

add.name: North wall (taped)
add.why: A wall 24 in (0.61 m) inside the north net, where skybeta-11's first follower run hit it on 2026-11-08 (taped at the hit). Its south face is the source map's north bound, 2.4384. Assumed: it runs the whole north side (measured only at the hit), 4 in thick, as tall as the other walls.

add.name: Diagonal wall (taped)
add.why: The organisers' new diagonal wall, taped: from Barrier 1's north face, 1.25 m east of the west net, to 1.40 m short of the original north net. Assumed: 0.10 m thick, as tall as the other walls. The taped gap from its top end to the north wall (about 3 ft) is wider than this, so the map errs narrow there (source README).

CP2 Gate A.why: The team (@jsun4231, 2026-11-08): on this map the route is the fastest way to the pad, and no checkpoint is a goal of its own. The published Gate A runs north from (0.3048, 2.1209), but only 0.32 m of it is south of the taped north wall, so no drone fits; the source map has no Gate A either. Scoring only (the SITL referee), and assumed: Gate A stays on its line, where the maze guideline ends, across the whole corridor from Barrier 3's north face to the north wall, which every route to the tunnel crosses (nav_traj/test/test_maps.py checks the whole drone does). Ask the organisers how Gate A is scored now.
